params.name: template_id
params.description: The template ID allows you to receive only the submissions created from that specific template.

params.name: q
params.description: Filter submissions based on submitter's name, email or phone partial match.

params.name: template_folder
params.description: Filter submissions by template folder name.

params.name: archived
params.description: Returns only archived submissions when `true` and only active submissions when `false`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of submissions to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 100.

params.name: after
params.description: The unique identifier of the submission to start the list from. It allows you to receive only submissions with an ID greater than the specified value. Pass ID value from the `pagination.next` response to load the next batch of submissions.

params.name: before
params.description: The unique identifier of the submission that marks the end of the list. It allows you to receive only submissions with an ID less than the specified value.

This API endpoint allows you to create submissions for a document template and send them to the specified email addresses. This is a simplified version of the POST /submissions API to be used with Zapier or other automation tools.

The API endpoint provides the functionality to create one-off submission request from a PDF. Use {{Field Name;role=Signer1;type=date}} text tags to define fillable fields in the document. See https://www.docuseal.com/examples/fieldtags.pdf for more text tag formats. Or specify the exact pixel coordinates of the document fields using `fields` param.
Related Guides
